Third-party software: AsmJit
============================

AsmJit is third-party code written by Petr Kobalicek and contributors. It is
not pyrlyn-jit code. AsmJit is not part of the pyrlyn-jit distribution, and
the pyrlyn-jit license (GPLv3 or commercial) does not apply to it.

Source:  https://github.com/asmjit/asmjit
Pinned:  commit 0464e1c (2026-10-16)
Path:    third_party/asmjit (a local git clone, gitignored; not committed to this
         repository)
License: Zlib (see third_party/asmjit/LICENSE.md, reproduced below)

Use: tests only
---------------
AsmJit is used only for testing. It is not part of the product: it is not
compiled into libpyrlyn-jit, not shipped and not distributed with it.
- Ported tests: src/asmjit_x64_tests.zig, src/asmjit_x86_tests.zig,
  src/asmjit_a64_tests.zig (expected bytes from AsmJit's assembler tests;
  run with -Dasmjit-tests=true; regenerated by scripts/gen_asmjit_tests.py and
  scripts/gen_asmjit_a64_tests.py)
- Reference binaries: bench/ref/asmjit_*.bin (machine code produced by AsmJit for
  the benchmark scenarios in bench/asmjit_bench.cpp)

Updating
--------
The pin is not updated routinely. To refresh:
    git clone https://github.com/asmjit/asmjit third_party/asmjit
    git -C third_party/asmjit checkout 0464e1c   # or a newer commit
    python3 scripts/gen_asmjit_tests.py
    python3 scripts/gen_asmjit_a64_tests.py
    zig build test -Dasmjit-tests=true
If the pin changes, update this file and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
